summary: Executed backend+frontend verification for new public X-avatar flow. 19/20 backend tests passed (13 existing registry regressions + 7 new X-avatar tests), and UI integration checks for NASA/fallback/export/routing/mobile passed. One backend requirement mismatch remains on avatar cache header.

critical.issue: Public endpoint response on production URL returns Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate instead of expected cacheable policy (max-age=3600). This failed the real-provider smoke assertion.

action_items: Fix effective cache-control behavior for /api/x/avatar/{handle} on the public deployment path so it matches product requirement (cacheable avatar response).
After header fix, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_x_avatar_api.py::test_nasa_avatar_proxy_headers_and_png_dimensions and full 13-case registry regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend route code sets Cache-Control public,max-age but live response seen by users is no-store; likely ingress/CDN/header override. This breaks the explicit contract for avatar caching.
Safety posture looks good in reviewed code: strict handle validation, host allowlist for avatar URL, redirect disabled, metadata-only Mongo cache, and timezone-aware TTL usage.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md. App has no auth credentials.
seed_data_creation: No registration submissions were made for NASA/LastZhood during UI testing. No permanent public identity record created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL used throughout: https://trading-hub-658.preview.emergentagent.com. NASA profile+avatar availability passed; LastZhood fallback to pixel portrait passed; canvas export (toDataURL) passed for both. Mobile overflow checks passed at widths 390 and 320. Only failing item is cache-control header mismatch on /api/x/avatar/NASA in public environment.
rca of the issue: Repro: GET https://trading-hub-658.preview.emergentagent.com/api/x/avatar/NASA. Expected per feature contract and backend code: cacheable avatar headers (max-age=3600). Actual: Cache-Control=no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate while other expected headers (image/png, CORS *, nosniff) are present. Likely root cause is deployment edge/ingress/security middleware overriding cache headers on image responses, not application route logic. Mitigation: inspect ingress/proxy header policy and preserve route-set Cache-Control for /api/x/avatar/* responses.
